"""Tmux execution backend — runs jobs in detached tmux sessions via SSH.

Extracted from core/tools/ssh.py. The logic is identical to the original
inline implementation; only the interface has been adapted to conform to
the ExecutionBackend protocol.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import shlex
from typing import Any

from core.tools.execution_backends.base import (
    ExecutionBackend,
    KillResult,
    LogResult,
    StatusResult,
    SubmitResult,
)

_SSH_TIMEOUT = 30


class TmuxBackend:
    """Execute training jobs in detached tmux sessions."""

    name: str = "tmux"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # submit_job
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def submit_job(
        self,
        conn: Any,
        *,
        exp_id: str,
        command: str,
        gpu_ids: list[str],
        work_dir: str,
        log_file: str,
        log_dir: str,
        env_activate: str,
        timeout_secs: int,
        wandb_key: str,
        cvd: str,
        sentinel_dir: str,
    ) -> SubmitResult:
        tmux_session = exp_id
        sentinel_path = f"{sentinel_dir}/{exp_id}.exit"

        setup_parts = [f"cd {shlex.quote(work_dir)}"]
        setup_parts.append(f"export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES={shlex.quote(cvd)}")
        if wandb_key:
            setup_parts.append(f"export WANDB_API_KEY=[REDACTED]}")
        if env_activate:
            setup_parts.append(env_activate)
        setup = " && ".join(setup_parts)

        write_sentinel = (
            f'_EC=$?; '
            f'echo "EXIT_CODE=$_EC" >> {log_file}; '
            f'printf "%s|%s\\n" "$_EC" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > {sentinel_path}'
        )
        inner_cmd = (
            f"rm -f {sentinel_path}; "
            f"mkdir -p {sentinel_dir}; "
            f"trap '{write_sentinel}' EXIT; "
            f"trap 'exit 129' HUP; "
            f"trap 'exit 130' INT; "
            f"trap 'exit 143' TERM; "
            f"{{ {setup} && "
            f"timeout {timeout_secs} env bash -c {shlex.quote(command)}"
            f"; }} > {log_file} 2>&1"
        )
        wrapped_cmd = (
            f"mkdir -p {log_dir} && "
            f"tmux new-session -d -s {shlex.quote(tmux_session)} "
            f"{shlex.quote(inner_cmd)}"
        )

        result = conn.run(wrapped_cmd, hide=True, warn=True, timeout=_SSH_TIMEOUT)
        if not result.ok:
            return SubmitResult(
                success=False,
                error=f"Failed to submit job: {result.stderr}",
            )

        pid_result = conn.run(
            f"tmux list-panes -t {shlex.quote(tmux_session)} -F '#{{pane_pid}}'",
            hide=True, warn=True, timeout=_SSH_TIMEOUT,
        )
        pid = pid_result.stdout.strip() if pid_result.ok else "unknown"

        return SubmitResult(
            success=True,
            job_handle=pid,
            log_path=log_file,
            extra={"tmux_session": tmux_session},
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # check_status
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def check_status(
        self,
        conn: Any,
        *,
        job_handle: str,
        exp_id: str | None = None,
        is_numeric: bool = True,
    ) -> StatusResult:
        import re
        _RE_PID = re.compile(r"^[0-9]+$")

        pid = job_handle
        _sentinel_key = exp_id or (pid if not is_numeric else None)

        # Fast path: exit sentinel
        if _sentinel_key:
            try:
                _RE_IDENTIFIER = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+$")
                if _RE_IDENTIFIER.match(_sentinel_key):
                    sentinel = f"/tmp/agent-ml-exit/{_sentinel_key}.exit"
                    sres = conn.run(
                        f"cat {sentinel} 2>/dev/null", hide=True, warn=True, timeout=_SSH_TIMEOUT,
                    )
                    if sres.ok and sres.stdout.strip():
                        raw = sres.stdout.strip().splitlines()[0]
                        code_s, _, finished_at = raw.partition("|")
                        try:
                            exit_code = int(code_s.strip())
                        except ValueError:
                            exit_code = None

                        if exit_code and exit_code != 0 and is_numeric:
                            ps_check = conn.run(
                                f"ps -p {pid} -o pid= --no-headers",
                                hide=True, warn=True, timeout=_SSH_TIMEOUT,
                            )
                            if ps_check.ok and ps_check.stdout.strip():
                                pass  # Fall through to slow path
                            else:
                                return StatusResult(
                                    status="completed",
                                    running=False,
                                    exit_code=exit_code,
                                    finished_at=finished_at.strip() or None,
                                    detection="sentinel",
                                    extra={"pid": pid},
                                )
                        else:
                            return StatusResult(
                                status="completed",
                                running=False,
                                exit_code=exit_code,
                                finished_at=finished_at.strip() or None,
                                detection="sentinel",
                                extra={"pid": pid},
                            )
            except Exception:
                pass

        # Slow path: ps + tmux
        pid_alive = False
        ps_stdout = ""
        if is_numeric:
            ps_result = conn.run(
                f"ps -p {pid} -o pid,stat,etime --no-headers",
                hide=True, warn=True, timeout=_SSH_TIMEOUT,
            )
            if ps_result.ok and ps_result.stdout.strip():
                parts_check = ps_result.stdout.strip().split()
                stat = parts_check[1] if len(parts_check) > 1 else ""
                pid_alive = not stat.startswith("Z")
                ps_stdout = ps_result.stdout.strip()

        tmux_result = conn.run(
            f"tmux has-session -t {shlex.quote(pid)} 2>/dev/null && echo yes || echo no",
            hide=True, warn=True, timeout=_SSH_TIMEOUT,
        )
        tmux_alive = tmux_result.stdout.strip() == "yes"

        if pid_alive:
            parts = ps_stdout.split()
            return StatusResult(
                status="running",
                running=True,
                detection="ps",
                extra={
                    "pid": parts[0] if parts else pid,
                    "process_state": parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else "unknown",
                    "elapsed_time": parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else "unknown",
                    "tmux_session_alive": tmux_alive,
                },
            )

        if tmux_alive:
            pane_cmd = f"tmux list-panes -t {shlex.quote(pid)} -F '#{{pane_pid}}' 2>/dev/null"
            pane_result = conn.run(pane_cmd, hide=True, warn=True, timeout=_SSH_TIMEOUT)
            pane_pids = [p.strip() for p in pane_result.stdout.strip().splitlines() if p.strip()]

            pane_has_children = False
            for ppid in pane_pids:
                child_check = conn.run(
                    f"pgrep -P {ppid} 2>/dev/null | head -1",
                    hide=True, warn=True, timeout=_SSH_TIMEOUT,
                )
                if child_check.ok and child_check.stdout.strip():
                    pane_has_children = True
                    break

            if pane_has_children:
                return StatusResult(
                    status="running",
                    running=True,
                    detection="tmux",
                    extra={
                        "pid": pid,
                        "tmux_session_alive": True,
                        "note": "tmux session alive with active child process",
                    },
                )
            return StatusResult(
                status="completed",
                running=False,
                detection="tmux",
                extra={
                    "pid": pid,
                    "tmux_session_alive": True,
                    "note": "tmux session alive but no child process running",
                },
            )

        return StatusResult(
            status="not_found",
            running=False,
            detection="ps",
            extra={
                "pid": pid,
                "tmux_session_alive": False,
            },
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # kill
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def kill(
        self,
        conn: Any,
        *,
        job_handle: str,
        is_numeric: bool = True,
    ) -> KillResult:
        pid = job_handle

        if is_numeric:
            conn.run(f"kill -TERM {pid} 2>/dev/null || true", hide=True, warn=True, timeout=_SSH_TIMEOUT)

        conn.run(
            f"tmux kill-session -t {shlex.quote(pid)} 2>/dev/null || true",
            hide=True, warn=True, timeout=_SSH_TIMEOUT,
        )

        still_alive = False
        if is_numeric:
            check = conn.run(
                f"ps -p {pid} -o pid --no-headers 2>/dev/null",
                hide=True, warn=True, timeout=_SSH_TIMEOUT,
            )
            still_alive = check.ok and check.stdout.strip() != ""

        if still_alive:
            conn.run(f"kill -9 {pid} 2>/dev/null || true", hide=True, warn=True, timeout=_SSH_TIMEOUT)

        return KillResult(success=True, force_killed=still_alive)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # tail_logs
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def tail_logs(
        self,
        conn: Any,
        *,
        log_path: str,
        n: int = 50,
    ) -> LogResult:
        result = conn.run(
            f'bash -c "tail -n {n} {log_path}"',
            hide=True, warn=True, timeout=_SSH_TIMEOUT,
        )
        if not result.ok:
            return LogResult(
                success=False,
                error=(
                    f"日志文件不存在或无法读取：{log_path}\n"
                    f"可能原因：\n"
                    f"  1. 路径中的 ~ 未展开（请用绝对路径）\n"
                    f"  2. 训练任务尚未创建日志文件\n"
                    f"  3. 日志路径与实际部署结构不符\n"
                    f"原始错误：{result.stderr.strip()}"
                ),
            )
        return LogResult(success=True, output=result.stdout.strip())

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # list_gpus — delegate to default nvidia-smi in ssh.py
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def list_gpus(
        self,
        conn: Any,
        *,
        server_config: dict[str, Any],
        account: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return None
